key_insight: SevenNet-Polar adds fast, accurate prediction of Born effective charges to an equivariant GNN, enabling charge-aware materials simulations alongside standard energy, force, and stress tasks.
engineering_relevance: This makes large-scale, electric-field-sensitive modeling more practical for battery and perovskite materials design, defect studies, and molecular dynamics workflows.
method: Built on the SevenNet equivariant graph neural network architecture
Trained both BEC-only and multitask models for energy, forces, stress, and BEC
Used acceleration via FlashTP to extend simulations to very large atom counts
evidence_signal: The abstract reports BEC RMSE as low as 0.0043 e for single-task models and 0.0029 e for multitask models, with energy/force/stress errors of 1.0 meV/atom, 12 meV/angstrom, and 0.05 GPa, respectively.
watch_item: Performance on BEC generalizes well, but scaling for diagonal and off-diagonal BEC components is less favorable than for energy, force, and stress, so out-of-domain validation remains important.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
